user_facing_summary:
Shading plan for `desert_wanderer`
Brief: Aged linen mummy wraps; hard one-step underside/far shadows; keep yellow eyes and skin peeks

Light: top-front / +X-up
Rules: one_step_darker, no_gradients

Overall:
Hard 1-2px shade bands. Linen #E8D9B8 → #C4B08A (or palette shadow_beige #A08884 on undersides); edge #C4B08A → #A08884; skin #8B5A3C → #6B4228; sash #8B6B4A → #6E5538. Never shade yellow eyes.

Per design layer (paint shadows on design/layers/ only):
  - upper_arm_far (3 stroke intent(s)): 2px underside + armpit fold; far limb slightly darker.
      · underside_bottom_edge → shadow_beige (#A08884)
      · armpit_fold → shadow_beige (#A08884)
      · far_limb_slightly_darker → shadow_beige (#A08884)
  - lower_arm_far (2 stroke intent(s)): Underside forearm band + far darkening.
      · underside_bottom_edge → shadow_beige (#A08884)
      · far_limb_slightly_darker → shadow_beige (#A08884)
  - upper_leg_far (3 stroke intent(s)): Thigh underside + joint fold; far slightly darker.
      · underside_bottom_edge → shadow_beige (#A08884)
      · joint_fold → shadow_beige (#A08884)
      · far_limb_slightly_darker → shadow_beige (#A08884)
  - lower_leg_far (3 stroke intent(s)): Shin underside, ankle fold, sole under foot.
      · underside_bottom_edge → shadow_beige (#A08884)
      · under_feet → shadow_beige (#A08884)
      · joint_fold → shadow_beige (#A08884)
  - torso (2 stroke intent(s)): Under-chest/waist fold; bottom torso edge; sash lower edge slightly darker.
      · underside_bottom_edge → shadow_beige (#A08884)
      · under_chest_waist_fold → shadow_beige (#A08884)
  - head (2 stroke intent(s)): Under-chin / jaw wrap underside only. Do not touch yellow eye pixels.
      · under_chin → shadow_beige (#A08884)
      · underside_bottom_edge → shadow_beige (#A08884)
  - upper_leg_near (2 stroke intent(s)): Thigh underside + joint fold.
      · underside_bottom_edge → shadow_beige (#A08884)
      · joint_fold → shadow_beige (#A08884)
  - lower_leg_near (3 stroke intent(s)): Shin underside, ankle fold, sole under foot.
      · underside_bottom_edge → shadow_beige (#A08884)
      · under_feet → shadow_beige (#A08884)
      · joint_fold → shadow_beige (#A08884)
  - upper_arm_near (2 stroke intent(s)): Armpit fold + underside lower edge.
      · armpit_fold → shadow_beige (#A08884)
      · underside_bottom_edge → shadow_beige (#A08884)
  - lower_arm_near (1 stroke intent(s)): Forearm underside band toward wrist/hand.
      · underside_bottom_edge → shadow_beige (#A08884)

Shade palette (one darker step from local flat color):
  - off_white (#DEC1B5) → shadow_beige (#A08884)
  - shadow_beige (#A08884) → muted_plum (#291A1F)
  - deep_red (#790F19) → muted_plum (#291A1F)
  - muted_plum (#291A1F) → muted_plum_alt (#3D2334)
  - muted_plum_alt (#3D2334) → near_black (#0E151C)
  - near_black_alt (#17171D) → near_black (#0E151C)
  - near_black (#0E151C) → near_black (#0E151C)

Apply with MCP paint tools only (fill_rect / draw_line / paint_pixels / paint_from_commands) on design layers — hard 1px–2px bands, no gradients, no Shell/PIL. Do not rewrite base geometry. Eyes live on the naked base head layer — shade design/head clothing only; do not clear or flood the head in a way that strips base eyes from compose underlays. Then compose_character (or re-compose). If this matches, say OK; otherwise revise the plan.
